items.title: A Topology-Feature Disentangled Deep Clustering Method for scRNA-seq Based on Graph-to-MLP Distillation.
items.title_zh: 一种基于图到MLP蒸馏的scRNA-seq拓扑特征解缠深度聚类方法。
items.summary_zh: 图神经网络（GNN）由于能够建模细胞间的拓扑关系，已逐渐成为单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据聚类分析的主流方法。然而，其实际应用仍面临以下挑战：（1）过度平滑破坏细胞异质性；（2）预构建图引入端到端依赖；（3）大规模细胞图计算密集。为充分利用scRNA-seq数据中的表达谱和拓扑信息并克服这些限制，本文提出一种融入AdaBoost原理的图到MLP（G2M）知识蒸馏方法，并在此基础上构建图解缠单细胞聚类框架——scAdaG2M。该框架利用GNN教师模型在细胞图上学习细胞间高阶拓扑关系和局部邻域结构，而多个轻量MLP学生模型在无图设置下进行特征学习。结合AdaBoost式动态重加权策略，该框架增强了对难以区分细胞、边界模糊细胞和潜在稀有细胞群的表征能力，从而缓解过度平滑导致的细胞异质性稀释。同时，该框架有效解耦基于图的建模与无图推理，减少对预构建图的端到端依赖，并显著降低大规模细胞图

extra.description: Graph neural networks (GNNs), owing to their ability to model topological relationships between cells, have gradually emerged as a mainstream approach in the clustering analysis of single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data. However, their practical application still faces the following challenges: (1) excessive smoothing undermines cellular heterogeneity; (2) pre-constructed graphs introduce end-to-end dependencies; (3) large-scale cellular graph computations are computationally intensive. To fully utilise the expression profiles and topological information contained within scRNA-seq data and overcome these limitations, this paper proposes a Graph-to-MLP (G2M) knowledge distillation method incorporating AdaBoost principles, and builds upon this to develop a graph-disentangled single-cell clustering framework-scAdaG2M. This framework utilises a GNN teacher model to learn higher-order topological relationships and local neighbourhood structures between cells on a cellular graph, whilst multiple lightweight MLP student models perform feature learning in an ungraphed setting. By combining this with an AdaBoost-style dynamic reweighting strategy, the framework enhances the model's ability to characterise cells that are difficult to distinguish, cells with blurred boundaries, and potentially rare cell populations, thereby mitigating the dilution of cellular heterogeneity caused by over-smoothing. At the same time, this framework effectively decouples graph-based modelling from graph-free reasoning, reduces the end-to-end reliance on pre-constructed graphs, and significantly reduces the computational overhead associated with large-scale cellular graphs. All datasets used in this study are publicly available. Detailed information about all the single-cell datasets analyzed in this paper is provided in Supplementary Table 1. The source code is available at https://github.com/gxl1110/scAdaG2M and https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21512950. Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

items.title: Biosemantic graph transfer learning for cross-patient cell type annotation and cell–cell interaction analysis in tumor single-cell RNA sequencing
items.title_zh: 用于肿瘤单细胞RNA测序中跨患者细胞类型注释和细胞—细胞相互作用分析的生物语义图迁移学习
items.summary_zh: 摘要 通过单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）探索肿瘤微环境（TME）内的细胞异质性，对于理解癌症进展和治疗反应至关重要。然而，当前scRNA-seq方法缺乏空间背景，并依赖不完整的配体—受体相互作用数据集，限制了准确的细胞类型注释和细胞—细胞通讯推断。本研究使用一种新型图神经网络模型应对这些挑战，增强细胞类型预测和细胞相互作用分析。我们的研究使用了来自19名患者、三种癌症类型（白血病、乳腺浸润性癌和结直肠癌）的49 024个细胞组成的数据集。所提出的scGSL模型表现出稳健性能，在所有数据集上平均准确率为84.83%，精确率为86.23%，召回率为81.51%，F1分数为80.92%。这些指标相较现有方法有显著提升，后者通常表现出较低的性能指标。此外，通过回顾现有关于TME内基因相互作用的文献，scGSL模型被证明能以无监督方式稳健识别具有生物学意义的基因相互作用，并通过多种癌症中关键

extra.description: Abstract The exploration of cellular heterogeneity within the tumor microenvironment (TME) via single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) is essential for understanding cancer progression and response to therapy. Current scRNA-seq approaches, however, lack spatial context and rely on incomplete datasets of ligand–receptor interactions, limiting accurate cell type annotation and cell–cell communication inference. This study addresses these challenges using a novel graph neural network model that enhances cell-type prediction and cell-interaction analysis. Our study utilized a dataset consisting of 49 024 cells from 19 patients across three cancer types: leukemia, breast invasive carcinoma, and colorectal cancer. The proposed scGSL model demonstrated robust performance, achieving an average accuracy of 84.83%, precision of 86.23%, recall of 81.51%, and an F1 score of 80.92% across all datasets. These metrics represent a significant enhancement over existing methods, which typically exhibit lower performance metrics. Additionally, by reviewing existing literature on gene interactions within the TME, the scGSL model proves to robustly identify biologically meaningful gene interactions in an unsupervised manner, validated by significant expression differences in key gene pairs across various cancers. The source code and data used in this study can be found at https://github.com/LiYuechao1998/scGSL.

items.title: GLAlign integrates single-cell multi-omics data via global manifold and local marker gene alignment
items.title_zh: GLAlign通过全局流形和局部标记基因比对整合单细胞多组学数据
items.summary_zh: 摘要 整合异质单细胞多组学数据集仍然具有挑战性，因为不同模态在 distinct 特征空间中测量，且缺乏细胞水平配对。现有流形比对或特征转换框架常受弱跨模态关联、几何模糊和过度校正影响。在此，我们提出GLAlign（全局流形和局部标记基因比对），这是一个优化框架，联合利用全局流形结构和局部标记基因信息来整合单细胞多组学数据。GLAlign通过由最大均值差异、失真和惩罚项组成的全局目标，以及由独立推断簇之间跨模态标记基因重叠引导的局部对比三元组损失，学习共享潜在空间。我们展示了GLAlign的方法学贡献，即通过生物学信息先验扩展流形比对，以确保几何上合理且生物学上正确的比对，而无需配对细胞或人工细胞类型注释。我们在模拟数据和真实数据集上评估了GLAlign，涵盖PBMC scRNA-seq/scATAC-seq、小鼠脑SNARE-seq、单供者和多批次CITE-seq，以及NCI-N87 s

extra.description: Abstract Integrating heterogeneous single-cell multi-omics datasets remains challenging because different modalities are measured in distinct feature spaces and lack cell level pairing. Existing manifold alignment or feature conversion framework are often affected by weak cross-modality associations, geometric ambiguity, and overcorrection. Here we present GLAlign (Global manifold and Local marker gene Alignment), an optimization framework that jointly leverages global manifold structure and local marker gene information to integrate single-cell multi-omics data. GLAlign learns a shared latent space through a global objective comprising maximum mean discrepancy, distortion, and penalty terms, together with a local contrastive triplet loss guided by cross-modality marker gene overlap between independently inferred clusters. We demonstrate GLAlign’s methodological contribution in extending the manifold alignment by biologically informed prior to ensure geometrically plausible and biologically correct alignments without requiring paired cells or manual cell type annotations. We evaluated GLAlign on simulated data and real datasets spanning PBMC scRNA-seq/scATAC-seq, mouse brain SNARE-seq, single-donor and multi-batch CITE-seq, and NCI-N87 scDNA-seq/scRNA-seq integration. Across the evaluated datasets, GLAlign achieved strong modality mixing and biological conservation, remained stable under moderate cell type imbalance and variations in clustering and marker information, and supported cross-modality label transfer and paired cell recovery. These results demonstrate that biologically structured coupling of global and local alignment provides an interpretable framework for heterogeneous single-cell multi-omics integration. GLAlign is freely available at https://github.com/Bateer-Bio/GLAlign.

items.title: Cd47 deficiency in mouse brain under excitotoxic stress
items.title_zh: 兴奋性毒性应激下小鼠大脑中Cd47的缺失
items.summary_zh: CD47是一种具有明确免疫和神经发育作用的跨膜蛋白，最近被鉴定为人类、非人灵长类和小鼠中丰富的突触前蛋白。为研究Cd47如何影响神经元应激和损伤，我们对暴露于惊厥剂量（KA25；25 mg/kg）或亚惊厥剂量（KA3；3 mg/kg）海人藻酸（KA）的野生型（WT）和Cd47敲除（KO）小鼠海马进行了单核RNA测序。将细胞类型注释与加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）相结合，揭示了不同的神经元和胶质基因模块，其共表达结构因基因型和KA暴露而异。值得注意的是，某些模块仅在Cd47缺陷细胞中显示出与KA相关的共表达结构变化。这些模块的富集分析突出了翻译、生物能量和突触基因集。使用Wasserstein距离比较全转录组分布表明，在所有十五个成对比较中，载体处理的KO细胞最接近暴露于KA3的WT细胞。这些发现表明，Cd47缺失使海马转录组向类似轻度兴奋性毒性应激的状态转变，暗示Cd47是神经元应激

extra.description: CD47, a transmembrane protein with well-established immune and neurodevelopmental roles, was recently identified as an abundant presynaptic protein in humans, non-human primates, and mice. To investigate how Cd47 influences neuronal stress and injury, we performed single-nucleus RNA sequencing of hippocampi from wild-type (WT) and Cd47 knockout (KO) mice exposed to kainic acid (KA) at convulsive (KA25; 25 mg/kg) or subconvulsive (KA3; 3 mg/kg) doses. Integrating cell-type annotations with Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis (WGCNA) revealed distinct neuronal and glial gene modules whose co-expression structure differed by genotype and by KA exposure. Notably, certain modules showed KA-associated changes in co-expression structure only in Cd47 -deficient cells. Enrichment analyses of these modules highlighted translational, bioenergetic, and synaptic gene sets. Comparing transcriptome-wide distributions using Wasserstein distance demonstrated that vehicle-treated KO cells most closely resembled WT cells exposed to KA3, of all fifteen pairwise comparisons. These findings suggest that Cd47 loss shifts the hippocampal transcriptome toward a state resembling mild excitotoxic stress, implicating Cd47 as a candidate regulator of neuronal stress adaptation and providing a hypothesis for testing that role.

items.title: HGMetaADR: a multimodal heterogeneous graph meta-learning framework for generalized adverse drug reaction prediction
items.title_zh: HGMetaADR：用于广义药物不良反应预测的多模态异质图元学习框架
items.summary_zh: 摘要 早期识别药物不良反应（ADR），即正常剂量用药后出现的有害或非预期反应，对于减少临床试验失败和相关经济成本至关重要。然而，现有ADR数据集常呈现长尾标签分布，且稀有副作用缺乏足够训练样本，使普通监督学习模型难以泛化到代表性不足的类别。为解决这些问题，我们提出HGMetaADR，一种用于ADR预测的新型基于异质图的元学习框架。该方法构建在多模态生物医学知识图上，整合互补的药物相关数据，包括分子结构、蛋白质序列、副作用和治疗适应症。它采用分层注意力机制捕捉异质实体间的语义依赖，并采用模型无关的元学习策略增强对小样本类别的适应能力。我们在少样本、零样本和多数三种情景下评估HGMetaADR，以模拟真实世界条件。大量实验表明，HGMetaADR始终优于最先进基线。此外，消融研究和通路富集分析揭示了连接蛋白质靶点、治疗适应症和副作用的潜在生物学机制，从而验证了将异质生物医学知识纳入ADR建模的

extra.description: Abstract Early identification of adverse drug reactions (ADRs), which refer to harmful or unintended responses to medications taken at normal doses, is crucial for reducing clinical trial failures and associated economic costs. However, existing ADR datasets often exhibit a long-tailed label distribution and lack sufficient training examples for rare side effects, making it difficult for vanilla supervised learning models to generalize to underrepresented classes. To address these issues, we propose HGMetaADR, a novel heterogeneous graph-based meta-learning framework for ADR prediction. Built upon a multimodal biomedical knowledge graph, this approach integrates complementary drug-related data, including molecular structures, protein sequences, side effects, and therapeutic indications. It employs a hierarchical attention mechanism to capture semantic dependencies across heterogeneous entities and adopts a model-agnostic meta-learning strategy to enhance adaptation to small-sample classes. We evaluate HGMetaADR under three scenarios—few-shot, zero-shot, and majority—to simulate real-world conditions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HGMetaADR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Furthermore, ablation studies and pathway enrichment analyses reveal the underlying biological mechanisms linking protein targets, therapeutic indications, and side effects, thereby validating the effectiveness of incorporating heterogeneous biomedical knowledge into ADR modeling.

items.title: A systematic review of EC number prediction algorithms based on reaction chemical structures.
items.title_zh: 基于反应化学结构的EC编号预测算法的系统综述。
items.summary_zh: 酶催化生物体中大多数代谢反应。酶的功能表征对于理解生物技术、营养学、生态学和药物开发等不同领域所涉及的代谢过程至关重要。酶委员会（EC）编号为分类酶促反应提供了一个层级框架，将基因和蛋白质序列与生化转化联系起来。然而，生化反应数据库的不完整注释限制了生物体代谢的准确表示。为弥补这一差距，已开发出多种从反应化学结构预测EC编号的计算方法，大致分为基于反应相似性和机器学习/深度学习方法。我们系统综述了这些工具，比较了它们从不同数据库预测EC编号的性能，并评估了它们跨酶类别的稳健性。我们还应用这些方法预测药物代谢反应的EC编号，突出它们在改善未表征代谢通路功能注释方面的潜力。重现本文结果所需的所有数据和代码均可在https://github.com/PlanesLab/ECNumberPrediction GitHub仓库和Zenodo https://doi.org/10.5281/zenod

extra.description: Enzymes catalyse most of the metabolic reactions in living organisms. The functional characterization of enzymes is critical to understand the metabolic processes involved in different fields such as biotechnology, nutrition, ecology, and drug development. The Enzyme Commission (EC) numbers provide a hierarchical framework for classifying enzymatic reactions, linking gene and protein sequences to biochemical transformations. However, the incomplete annotation of biochemical reaction databases limits the accurate representation of metabolism of living organisms. To address this gap, several computational methods have been developed to predict EC numbers from reaction chemical structures, broadly classified into reaction similarity-based and machine/deep learning approaches. We systematically review these tools, comparing their performance predicting EC numbers from different databases, and assessing their robustness across enzyme classes. We also apply these methods to predict EC numbers from drug metabolism reactions, highlighting their potential to improve functional annotation of uncharacterized metabolic pathways. All the necessary data and code to reproduce the results of this manuscript are available within https://github.com/PlanesLab/ECNumberPrediction GitHub repository and in Zenodo https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22957403. Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

items.title: ASAOT: an accentuated structure-differentiated asymmetric optimal transport model for cell type and single-cell spatial mapping
items.title_zh: ASAOT：一种用于细胞类型和单细胞空间映射的增强结构差异化非对称最优传输模型
items.summary_zh: 摘要 空间转录组学（STs）表征时空基因表达，并促进对组织微环境中细胞结构和细胞间通讯的分析。然而，现有空间解卷积方法采用全局固定平滑而无局部锐化，这会模糊细胞边界并阻碍脑组织中分层、异质性细胞模式的重建。在此，我们提出增强结构差异化非对称最优传输（ASAOT），一个基于结构增强非对称最优传输的解卷积框架。结合空间邻域约束，ASAOT引入差异化增强锐化项以维持全局空间连续性、增强边界检测并保留斑点级表达异质性。利用非对称最优传输，该框架联合估计斑点级细胞类型比例并对参考单细胞坐标进行空间分配。在多种模拟数据集上的基准测试表明，ASAOT在中等空间分辨率下实现了有竞争力的整体准确性和稳健性，在测试方法中平均综合排名最佳。应用于小鼠嗅球和大脑皮层数据集表明，ASAOT减少了信号扩散和边界失真，有效恢复分层脑解剖结构和分层细胞分布，从而构建参考单细胞图谱的可解释空间图。总体而言，ASAOT通过锐

extra.description: Abstract Spatial transcriptomics (STs) characterizes spatiotemporal gene expression and facilitates analysis of cellular architecture and cell–cell crosstalk within tissue microenvironments. However, existing spatial deconvolution methods employ globally fixed smoothing without local sharpening, which blurs cellular boundaries and impedes reconstruction of layered, heterogeneous cellular patterns in brain tissue. Here, we present Accentuated Structure-differentiated Asymmetric Optimal Transport (ASAOT), a deconvolution framework built on structure-enhanced asymmetric optimal transport. Coupled with spatial neighborhood constraints, ASAOT introduces a differentiated accentuated sharpening term to maintain global spatial continuity, enhance boundary detection, and preserve spot-level expression heterogeneity. Using asymmetric optimal transport, the framework jointly estimates spot-wise cell-type proportions and performs spatial assignment of reference single-cell coordinates. Benchmarks on diverse simulated datasets demonstrate that ASAOT achieves competitive overall accuracy and robustness across moderate spatial resolutions, with the best average comprehensive rank among tested methods. Applications to mouse olfactory bulb and cerebral cortex datasets demonstrate that ASAOT reduces signal diffusion and boundary distortion, effectively recovering layered brain anatomy and stratified cell distributions to build interpretable spatial maps of reference single-cell profiles. Collectively, ASAOT addresses critical drawbacks of conventional methods via a sharpening regularization term, serving as a reliable tool for STs analysis and mechanism exploration of tissue spatial organization.

items.title: spOT-NMF: gene expression deconvolution via optimal transport with proximity-aware niche mapping for spatial transcriptomics
items.title_zh: spOT-NMF：通过最优传输与邻近感知生态位映射进行基因表达反卷积用于空间转录组学
items.summary_zh: 摘要 空间转录组学能够直接分析完整组织内的细胞组织，然而两个挑战限制了其充分利用：混合表达信号（包括异种移植等物种混合模型）的准确无参考反卷积，以及缺乏能将每个斑点的程序使用值转化为空间生态位的工具。我们开发了spOT-NMF，一种基于最优传输的非负矩阵分解方法，用Wasserstein距离替代标准重建损失，无需匹配的单细胞图谱即可解开混合信号。虽然广义OT-NMF分解适用于任何表达矩阵，但基于邻近性的生态位推断模块进一步将空间转录组中的程序共使用转化为定义组织区室及其边界的方向共现网络。在涵盖亚细胞到多细胞分辨率、多个平台和两种物种混合场景的五个金标准数据集上进行基准测试，spOT-NMF在无参考方法中排名第一，在异种移植特有的信号不平衡条件下尤其具有优势。我们表明无参考反卷积能够恢复匹配单细胞图谱中缺失的细胞群体，突显了无监督分析的价值。应用于胶质母细胞瘤异种移植和人类结直肠癌，spO

extra.description: Abstract Spatial transcriptomics enables direct profiling of cellular organization within intact tissues, yet two challenges limit its full exploitation: accurate reference-free deconvolution of mixed expression signals (including species-admixed models such as xenografts), and lack of tools that can translate per-spot program usage values into spatial niches. We developed spOT-NMF, an optimal transport-based non-negative matrix factorization method that replaces standard reconstruction loss with the Wasserstein distance to disentangle mixed signals without requiring matched single-cell atlases. While the generalized OT-NMF factorization is applicable to any expression matrix, a proximity-based niche inference module further translates program co-usage from spatial transcriptomes into directional co-occurrence networks that define tissue compartments and their boundaries. Benchmarking across five gold-standard datasets spanning sub-cellular to multi-cellular resolutions, multiple platforms, and two-species admixture scenarios, spOT-NMF ranks first among reference-free methods, with particular advantage under the signal imbalance conditions characteristic of xenografts. We show that reference-free deconvolution recovers cell populations absent from matched single-cell atlases, highlighting the value of unsupervised analysis. Applied to glioblastoma xenografts and human colorectal cancer, spOT-NMF reveals spatially restricted interferon signaling, invasion routes, and CAF–tumor boundaries. spOT-NMF is available as an open-source Python package with GPU, CPU, and HPC support.

items.title: Identifying multi-omics spatial domains via masked autoencoder and diffusion-based latent regularization with SpaMEDM
items.title_zh: 通过掩码自编码器和基于扩散的潜在正则化与SpaMEDM识别多组学空间域
items.summary_zh: 摘要 空间多组学数据提供了组织组织的互补分子视图。然而，由于数据稀疏性、技术噪声和模态特异性分布，其整合仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们提出了空间掩码自编码器和基于扩散的模型（SpaMEDM），一个端到端图表示学习框架，它增强了双注意力图整合骨干，并加入了掩码重建和基于扩散的潜在噪声预测正则化。在掩码轨道中，通过利用模态和图特定的邻域信息来恢复随机掩码的斑点特征。同时，在随机采样的噪声水平下对模态特定的潜在表示施加高斯扰动，并训练一个空间图信息网络来预测注入的噪声。这种基于扩散的目标仅在训练期间使用，以鼓励对潜在扰动的鲁棒性，而不是在推理期间执行迭代反向扩散或采样。此外，基于余弦的配对斑点方向对齐和邻接重建鼓励兼容的跨模态表示并保留所选图结构。SpaMEDM灵活支持纯空间、双特征-空间和模态特定特征修剪的空间图配置。在不同空间多组学数据集上的评估展示了有竞争力的空间域识别性能，并产生促进下游探

extra.description: Abstract Spatial multi-omics data provide complementary molecular views of tissue organization. However, their integration remains challenging due to data sparsity, technical noise, and modality-specific distributions. Here, we present Spatial Masked autoEncoder and Diffusion-based Model (SpaMEDM), an end-to-end graph representation learning framework that augments a dual-attention graph-integration backbone with masked reconstruction and diffusion-based latent noise-prediction regularization. In the masked track, randomly masked spot features are recovered by leveraging modality- and graph-specific neighborhood information. In parallel, Gaussian perturbations are applied to modality-specific latent representations at randomly sampled noise levels, and a spatial-graph-informed network is trained to predict the injected noise. This diffusion-based objective is used exclusively during training to encourage robustness to latent perturbations, rather than to perform iterative reverse diffusion or sampling during inference. Furthermore, cosine-based paired-spot directional alignment and adjacency reconstruction encourage compatible cross-modality representations and preservation of the selected graph structure. SpaMEDM flexibly supports purely spatial, dual feature–spatial, and modality-specific feature-pruned spatial graph configurations. Evaluations across diverse spatial multi-omics datasets demonstrate competitive spatial-domain identification performance and produce integrated embeddings that facilitate downstream exploratory analyses.

items.title: Structured multi-view relational learning for drug response prediction
items.title_zh: 用于药物反应预测的结构化多视图关系学习
items.summary_zh: 摘要 药物反应预测（DRP）需要能够联合表征分子药物结构和异质细胞状态的模型。尽管近期深度学习方法已将多组学图谱与药物表征整合，但许多方法将组学视图视为并行特征来源或在关系建模前将其合并，这可能削弱组学视图特异的细胞系关系结构。在此，我们提出MulDR，一个结构化多视图关系学习框架，在药物条件化的细胞–药物交互之前保留组学视图特异的细胞系关系结构。MulDR为通路活性、基因表达、突变和DNA甲基化构建独立的关系结构，学习视图特异的关系细胞表征，并使用互补的基序级、几何感知分子图和Morgan指纹药物表征来条件化其融合。通过这种设计，细胞系相似性在交互阶段之前保持视图依赖，而非被过早压缩为单一特征或关系空间。大量实验表明，MulDR在相同评估协议下持续优于代表性和近期基线，相对于最强基线将均方根误差降低6.07%。对未见药物和细胞系的冷启动评估进一步表明MulDR能泛化到先前未见的实体，而消

extra.description: Abstract Drug response prediction (DRP) requires models that jointly characterize molecular drug structure and heterogeneous cellular states. Although recent deep learning approaches have integrated multi-omics profiles with drug representations, many treat omics views as parallel feature sources or merge them before relational modeling, which can weaken omics-view-specific cell-line relation structures. Here, we propose MulDR, a structured multi-view relational learning framework that preserves omics-view-specific cell-line relation structures before drug-conditioned cell–drug interaction. MulDR constructs separate relation structures for pathway activity, gene expression, mutation, and DNA methylation, learns view-specific relational cell representations, and uses complementary motif-level, geometry-aware molecular graph, and Morgan fingerprint drug representations to condition their fusion. With this design, cell-line similarity remains view-dependent until the interaction stage, rather than being prematurely compressed into a single feature or relation space. Extensive experiments show that MulDR consistently outperforms representative and recent baselines under the same evaluation protocol, reducing root mean square error by 6.07% relative to the strongest baseline. Cold-start evaluations on unseen drugs and cell lines further show that MulDR generalizes to previously unseen entities, while ablation studies show that removing either view-specific relational modeling or drug-conditioned fusion consistently compromises predictive performance. Together, these results suggest that preserving omics-specific cell-line relations before drug-conditioned interaction modeling provides an effective strategy for robust DRP.

items.title: Multi-omics survival prediction under modality incompleteness via dynamic modality graphs and product-of-experts fusion
items.title_zh: 通过动态模态图和专家乘积融合在模态不完整下的多组学生存预测
items.summary_zh: 摘要 多组学数据整合为癌症生存预测提供了丰富的互补信息，然而模态不完整在真实医疗数据中普遍存在，削弱了现有模型的稳定性和适用性。为应对这一挑战，我们提出DMG-PoE，一个用于多组学生存预测的稳健学习框架。该框架引入动态模态图（DMG），在模态节点之间传播互补信息以补偿缺失输入，并结合不确定性感知的专家乘积（PoE）融合机制，按每个模态的估计精度自适应加权，以及一致性约束训练策略，在不同模态子集上稳定预测。在SurvBoard基准上对10种TCGA癌症类型和七种组学模态的系统评估表明，DMG-PoE在标准设置（完整模态训练/测试）和缺失增强设置（训练额外包含真实不完整样本和非临床模态丢弃，仅完整测试）下均取得最高平均C-index；受控的逐模态掩蔽实验在22/24个癌症-模态组合中验证了有效的测试时恢复，而仅七种模态中两种可用时的跨队列迁移进一步证实了严重输入限制下的泛化能力。

extra.description: Abstract Multi-omics data integration provides rich complementary information for cancer survival prediction, yet modality incompleteness is pervasive in real-world medical data and undermines the stability and applicability of existing models. To address this challenge, we propose DMG-PoE, a robust learning framework for multi-omics survival prediction. The framework introduces a dynamic modality graph (DMG) that propagates complementary information across modality nodes to compensate for missing inputs, combined with an uncertainty-aware product-of-experts (PoE) fusion mechanism that adaptively weights each modality by its estimated precision, and a consistency-constrained training strategy that stabilizes predictions across varying modality subsets. Systematic evaluation on the SurvBoard benchmark across 10 TCGA cancer types and seven omics modalities demonstrates that DMG-PoE achieves the highest average C-index under both the standard setting (complete-modality training/testing) and the missing-augmented setting (training additionally includes real incomplete samples and nonclinical modality dropout, with complete-only testing); controlled per-modality masking experiments validate effective test-time recovery in 22/24 cancer-modality combinations, and cross-cohort transfer with only two of seven modalities available further confirms generalization under severe input restriction.

items.title: Impact of training data on deep learning–based RNA 3D structure quality assessment
items.title_zh: 训练数据对基于深度学习的RNA 3D结构质量评估的影响
items.summary_zh: 摘要 对预测RNA 3D结构进行准确的免参考评估对于大规模RNA建模至关重要，但训练数据对基于深度学习的质量预测器的影响仍知之甚少。在此，我们对三个用于RNA 3D结构质量评估的深度学习预测器进行了系统的交叉训练分析，每个预测器最初都在不同的训练集上开发。通过在替代（非原生）数据集上重新训练每个预测器——包括专门为本项目创建的新数据集RNA3DQA——并在独立的RNA-Puzzles基准上评估性能，我们系统地评估了模型架构和训练数据组成的相对贡献。我们的结果揭示了跨数据集泛化方面的显著差异，预测器在非原生数据集上训练时往往比在其原生数据集上表现更好。值得注意的是，训练数据集的影响因预测器而异，RNA3DQA特别为ARES模型带来了整体最佳的准确性和排名稳定性结果。原生训练集为RNA3DCNN和lociPARSE带来了更好的性能。这些发现表明，训练数据的特征在塑造免参考RNA 3D结构质量评

extra.description: Abstract Accurate reference-free assessment of predicted RNA 3D structures is essential for large-scale RNA modeling, yet the impact of training data on deep learning–based quality predictors remains poorly understood. Here, we present a systematic cross-training analysis of three deep learning predictors for RNA 3D structure quality assessment, each originally developed on distinct training sets. By retraining each predictor on alternative (nonnative) datasets—including RNA3DQA, a new set created specifically for this project—and evaluating performance on independent RNA-Puzzles benchmarks, we systematically assess the relative contributions of model architecture and training data composition. Our results reveal pronounced differences in cross-dataset generalization, with predictors often performing better when trained on nonnative datasets than on their native ones. Notably, the impact of the training datasets varied across predictors, with RNA3DQA yielding the overall best accuracy and ranking stability results specifically for the ARES model. Native training sets yielded better performance for RNA3DCNN and lociPARSE. These findings demonstrate that the characteristics of the training data play a dominant, model-dependent role in shaping the performance and robustness of reference-free RNA 3D structure quality assessment methods. We conclude with practical recommendations for designing transferable training datasets and for benchmarking deep learning–based quality predictors in RNA structural bioinformatics.

items.title: Multi-omics-constrained kinetic models quantify pathway rewiring and predict metabolic vulnerabilities in BRCA1-deficient ovarian cancer.
items.title_zh: 多组学约束的动力学模型量化通路重连并预测BRCA1缺陷卵巢癌的代谢脆弱性。
items.summary_zh: 癌症代谢重编程的时间分辨、网络范围后果仍知之甚少。我们为同基因BRCA1野生型和BRCA1突变卵巢癌细胞构建了多组学约束的近基因组规模动力学集成模型。覆盖超过2，100个反应，这些集成模型能够对营养物、代谢物和酶扰动进行不确定性量化模拟。代谢控制分析识别出28个酶介导的脆弱性；其中24个与实验性或已批准的DrugBank化合物相关，而4个缺乏 documented 药物关联。独立的DepMap数据支持其中一部分候选。所有28个均直接源自机制模型结构和多组学约束，未对已知药物靶点或癌症依赖性数据进行校准。对胸苷酸合成酶、己糖激酶和三激酶抑制的模拟预测了通路使用、能量代谢以及共享神经酰胺相关应激反应的靶点和生理特异性变化。将预测的酶活性变化映射到BRCA1相关转录因子，提示了两种状态之间差异的调控路径。这些集成模型为跨癌症和其他疾病的时间分辨、机制假设生成提供了可复用框架。本文透明同行评审过程

extra.description: Time-resolved, network-wide consequences of cancer metabolic reprogramming remain poorly understood. We built multi-omics-constrained, near-genome-scale kinetic ensembles for isogenic BRCA1 wild-type and BRCA1-mutant ovarian cancer cells. Covering over 2,100 reactions, the ensembles enabled uncertainty-quantified simulations of nutrient, metabolite, and enzyme perturbations. Metabolic control analysis identified 28 enzyme-mediated vulnerabilities; 24 are linked to experimental or approved DrugBank compounds, whereas four lack documented drug associations. Independent DepMap data supported a subset of these candidates. All 28 emerged directly from the mechanistic model structure and multi-omics constraints, with no calibration to known drug targets or cancer-dependency data. Simulations of thymidylate synthase, hexokinase, and triokinase inhibition predicted target- and physiology-specific changes in pathway use, energy metabolism, and a shared ceramide-linked stress response. Mapping predicted enzyme-activity shifts to BRCA1-associated transcription factors suggested regulatory routes underlying differences between the two states. These ensembles provide a reusable framework for time-resolved, mechanistic hypothesis generation across cancers and other diseases. A record of this paper's transparent peer review process is included in the supplemental information.

items.title: Analyzing epigenetic modifications at sample-specific CpG loci in long-read data using a likelihood-based framework in bsseq.
items.title_zh: 在bsseq中使用基于似然的框架分析长读长数据中样本特异性CpG位点的表观遗传修饰。
items.summary_zh: 脊椎动物基因组中CpG背景下的DNA常发生表观遗传修饰，这增加了其突变率。然而，识别样本特异性CpG位点以分析表观遗传修饰仍具挑战性。在此，我们提出一种基于读长的似然框架，用于在Nanopore和PacBio平台的单分子长读长测序数据中高精度和高灵敏度地识别参考和非参考CpG位点。纳入所有样本特异性CpG位点增加了可分析位点数量并减少了修饰水平估计中的偏差，这两个因素对准确分析表观遗传修饰至关重要。该似然框架在R包bsseq中实现，源代码可在github https://github.com/hansenlab/bsseq获取。长读长分析和基于似然的CpG位点过滤的安装说明和用户指南可在Bioconductor https://www.bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/bsseq.html获取。补充数据可在Bioinformatics在

extra.description: DNA in CpG context is often epigenetically modified in vertebrate genomes which increases their mutation rate. However, it remains challenging to identify sample-specific CpG loci for analysis of epigenetic modifications. Here, we present a read-based likelihood framework for identifying reference and non-reference CpG loci with high precision and sensitivity in single-molecule long-read sequencing data from Nanopore and PacBio platforms. Including all sample-specific CpG loci increases the number of analyzable loci and reduces bias in modification level estimates, both critical factors for accurate analyses of epigenetic modifications. The likelihood framework is implemented in the R package bsseq with the source code available on github https://github.com/hansenlab/bsseq. Installation instructions and a user guide for long-read analysis and likelihood-based filtering of CpG loci are available on Bioconductor https://www.bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/bsseq.html. Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

items.title: Integer quantized multilayer perceptron neural network for lossless compression of nanopore signal.
items.title_zh: 用于纳米孔信号无损压缩的整数量化多层感知器神经网络。
items.summary_zh: 纳米孔测序对于高级基因组分析不可或缺，但原始信号输出产生了巨大的存储和带宽需求。已提出VBZ和ex-zd等专用无模型压缩器来应对这一挑战。它们提供高吞吐量和强压缩性能，但无法充分利用高阶统计依赖性，这限制了进一步收益。基于学习的压缩器可实现更好的压缩比，但通常引入浮点非确定性且对于大规模纳米孔数据集太慢，降低了其实用性。我们介绍SigComp，一种用于纳米孔信号数据的学习型无损压缩器。SigComp采用紧凑的多层感知器网络，具有固定上下文窗口，以捕获主导的单字节信号增量中的高阶依赖性。通过集成训练后量化和完全GPU原生的范围编码器，SigComp消除了自回归编码循环中的GPU-CPU同步开销，同时确保跨不同执行设置的严格位精确性。在不同物种和测序化学（DNA R10.4.1和RNA004）上的评估表明，SigComp相比VBZ和ex-zd分别持续将压缩文件大小减少6.00%-7.09%和3

extra.description: Nanopore sequencing is indispensable for advanced genomic analyses, but the raw signal output creates substantial storage and bandwidth demands. Specialized model-free compressors such as VBZ and ex-zd have been proposed to address this challenge. They deliver high throughput and strong compression performance, yet they cannot fully exploit higher-order statistical dependencies, which limits further gains. Learning-based compressors can achieve better compression ratios, but they often introduce floating-point non-determinism and are too slow for large-scale nanopore datasets, reducing their practicality. We introduce SigComp, a learned lossless compressor for nanopore signal data. SigComp employs a compact multilayer perceptron network with a fixed context window to capture higher-order dependencies within the dominant one-byte signal deltas. By integrating post-training quantization and a fully GPU-native range coder, SigComp eliminates GPU-CPU synchronization overhead in the autoregressive coding loop while ensuring strict bit-exactness across diverse execution settings. Evaluations on diverse species and sequencing chemistries (DNA R10.4.1 and RNA004) demonstrate that SigComp consistently reduces compressed file sizes by 6.00%-7.09% and 3.86%-5.34% over VBZ and ex-zd, respectively, albeit with a 10× lower processing throughput. Compared to the leading neural compressor, SigComp achieves a comparable compression ratio, sacrificing merely 0.4%-1.9%, while delivering 46-74× higher throughput. Ablation studies confirm that SigComp's integer-only, GPU-native approach improves throughput by 7.75-8.30× overall over hybrid GPU-CPU pipelines without model quantization, and the default 64-symbol context window effectively captures the vast majority of exploitable redundancy. SigComp can also be extended to lossy compression by eliminating the least significant bits, and achieve compression ratios of 4.047-4.868, outperforming lossy ex-zd by 9.18%-14.38%. Although processing remains slower than specialized codecs, SigComp offers an excellent trade-off for long-term cold archival storage, particularly when scaled via multi-GPU environments. SigComp is freely available on GitHub at: https://github.com/BioinfoSZU/SigComp. It supports CPU-only, NVIDIA, and AMD GPU execution backends with seamless cross-platform archive interoperability, as well as multi-GPU scaling. Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

items.title: The Biodiversity Cell Atlas database: a curated resource for comparative single-cell genomics across the eukaryotic tree of life.
items.title_zh: 生物多样性细胞图谱数据库：一个用于真核生命树比较单细胞基因组学的精选资源。
items.summary_zh: 单细胞基因组学改变了细胞多样性研究，但由此产生的图谱分散在出版物、格式和注释标准中。使其可查找和互操作的努力主要集中于聚合和协调现有模式生物数据集。生物多样性细胞图谱数据库是一个开放资源，通过统一（重新）处理、精选和比较跨真核生命树采样的全生物体单细胞图谱来弥补这一差距。从原始测序数据开始，每个数据集通过一致的工作流处理，并 enriched 标准化质量控制指标、元细胞级聚合、基因共表达模块以及基于系统发育的直系同源和功能注释，使得物种内以基因和细胞类型为中心的探索以及物种间有原则的比较成为可能。该门户目前托管来自13个真核门33个物种的39个数据集，并提供多级访问，从原始和过滤计数矩阵到标准化、聚合和分析就绪的数据层。这些可通过交互式网络界面（https://portal.biodiversitycellatlas.org）和文档化的REST API（https://portal.bio

extra.description: Single-cell genomics has transformed the study of cellular diversity, but the resulting atlases are scattered across publications, formats, and annotation standards. Efforts to make these data findable and interoperable have focused largely on aggregating and harmonizing existing model organism datasets. The Biodiversity Cell Atlas database is an open resource that addresses this gap by uniformly (re)processing, curating, and comparing whole-organism single-cell atlases sampled across the eukaryotic tree of life. Starting from raw sequencing data, each dataset is processed through a consistent workflow and enriched with standardized quality-control metrics, metacell-level aggregation, gene co-expression modules, and phylogeny-based orthology and functional annotation, enabling both gene- and cell type-centric exploration within species as well as principled comparisons between them. The portal currently hosts 39 datasets across 33 species spanning 13 eukaryotic phyla, and offers multiple levels of access, from raw and filtered count matrices to normalized, aggregated, and analysis-ready data layers. These are accessible through an interactive web interface (https://portal.biodiversitycellatlas.org) and a documented REST API (https://portal.biodiversitycellatlas.org/api/v1/). All data, code, and infrastructure are continuously released and maintained under open licenses, providing a curated and reusable foundation for comparative single-cell genomics.

items.title: PANGEA: an integrated cell atlas across diverse biological contexts enables systematic profiling of multicellular responses in human diseases.
items.title_zh: PANGEA：一个跨多样生物背景的集成细胞图谱，能够系统分析人类疾病中的多细胞反应。
items.summary_zh: 疾病影响组织内多种细胞类型，但人类疾病中多细胞反应的整体景观仍 largely 未探索。在此，我们基于人类细胞重映射图谱PANGEA对人类疾病的多细胞反应进行分类，该图谱整合了来自自动处理公共存储库原始序列文件流水线的1260万个细胞。我们构建了一个层级细胞分类框架，包含32个主要细胞类型和165个细胞亚型。基于此注释框架，我们探索了一个广泛的人类细胞图谱，包含来自48个器官160种疾病的4650万个细胞，并揭示了跨器官反复发现的人类疾病核心原型。我们表明，该细胞图谱还可作为空间转录组学中无偏分析的参考，揭示与免疫治疗反应相关的空间特征。总体而言，我们的研究为细胞本体提供了基础资源，使得人类疾病中细胞特征的跨组织比较成为可能。

extra.description: Diseases affect multiple cell types within tissues, but the overall landscape of the multicellular responses in human diseases remains largely unexplored. Here we categorize the multicellular responses of human diseases based on a remapped atlas of human cells, PANGEA, incorporating 12.6 million cells acquired from a pipeline that automatically processes raw sequence files from public repositories. We constructed a hierarchical cell classification framework comprising 32 major cell types and 165 cellular subtypes. On the basis of this annotation framework, we explored an extensive atlas of human cells containing 46.5 million cells from 160 diseases across 48 organs and revealed core archetypes of human diseases repeatedly found across organs. We show that this cell atlas could also serve as a reference for unbiased analysis in spatial transcriptomics, revealing spatial features associated with immunotherapy responses. Collectively, our study provides foundational resources for cell ontologies, enabling cross-tissue comparisons of cellular features in human diseases.

items.title: 基于威胁感知的Tor多路径选择
items.title_zh: 基于威胁感知的Tor多路径选择
items.summary_zh: 随着机器学习和深度学习的发展应用,攻击者可以通过Tor用户链路上的恶意节点以及恶意AS对其进行流量分析,从而对Tor用户进行去匿名化攻击。目前,常见的针对流量分析攻击的防御方法有两类:一类是通过插入虚拟数据包,或者延迟真实数据包从而改变流量特征,这种方法会引入带宽和时延开销;另一类将用户流量分割并通过多个路径传输从而进行防御,这种方法缺少对电路上存在的恶意节点以及恶意AS的感知,当攻击者搜集到完整流量踪迹时,依旧难以抵御流量分析对Tor用户的去匿名化攻击。为了弥补多路径防御方法在路径选择上存在的缺乏威胁感知的问题,提出了融合恶意节点感知以及恶意AS感知的基于威胁感知的多路径选择算法。首先提出一种改进的节点距离度量的方法,然后使用改进后的距离度量,基于K-Mediods算法对节点进行聚类,提高了恶意节点的检测效果;之后改进了AS感知算法,提高了匿名性要求;最后融合恶意节点检测以及AS感知算法

extra.description: 随着机器学习和深度学习的发展应用,攻击者可以通过Tor用户链路上的恶意节点以及恶意AS对其进行流量分析,从而对Tor用户进行去匿名化攻击。目前,常见的针对流量分析攻击的防御方法有两类:一类是通过插入虚拟数据包,或者延迟真实数据包从而改变流量特征,这种方法会引入带宽和时延开销;另一类将用户流量分割并通过多个路径传输从而进行防御,这种方法缺少对电路上存在的恶意节点以及恶意AS的感知,当攻击者搜集到完整流量踪迹时,依旧难以抵御流量分析对Tor用户的去匿名化攻击。为了弥补多路径防御方法在路径选择上存在的缺乏威胁感知的问题,提出了融合恶意节点感知以及恶意AS感知的基于威胁感知的多路径选择算法。首先提出一种改进的节点距离度量的方法,然后使用改进后的距离度量,基于K-Mediods算法对节点进行聚类,提高了恶意节点的检测效果;之后改进了AS感知算法,提高了匿名性要求;最后融合恶意节点检测以及AS感知算法提出了一种基于威胁感知的多路径选择算法。实验结果表明,该算法不仅能抵抗多种流量分析攻击,而且保证了一定的Tor电路性能。

items.title: 基于多智能体深度强化学习的SD-IoT控制器部署
items.title_zh: 基于多智能体深度强化学习的SD-IoT控制器部署
items.summary_zh: 物联网(IoT)中激增的流量, 影响了传感器等设备的数据传输。利用软件定义网络(SDN)技术可以优化网络性能, 提高数据传输质量。然而, 物联网中流量等网络状态的不断变化会影响软件定义网络控制平面的性能。研究软件定义物联网(SD-IoT)中的动态控制器部署问题, 以在流量变化时保证控制平面性能。考虑到物联网节点的能耗以及数据传输的特点, 在部署控制器时, 综合考虑延迟、控制可靠性以及能耗的影响, 并将该问题构建为马尔可夫博弈过程。为了同时兼顾单一控制器性能以及控制平面整体性能, 采用多智能体深度强化学习求解该问题。在部署阶段利用动作掩码屏蔽部分节点, 避免将控制器部署在性能不足或者供能不方便的节点。仿真实验表明, 与基于Louvain社区划分和基于单智能体深度Q网络(DQN)的部署算法相比, 所提算法可以更好地找到高性能的部署方案。

items.title: 云网融合环境下组合服务的动态重构

items.title: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
items.title_zh: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
items.summary_zh: 在高速收费站拥堵检测场景中, 遮挡、阴影、景深等因素严重影响检测算法的精度, 基于单信息的拥堵检测算法无法准确反映收费站真实拥堵情况, 对此, 提出一种高速收费站多信息融合拥堵检测算法。首先采用目标检测算法检测目标区域车辆, 利用图像空间特征计算车道占用率; 其次利用Deep SORT目标跟踪算法与滑动平衡机制进行车流量综合估计, 减少因为遮挡和阴影导致的车辆误检、漏检问题; 最后利用基于光流信息熵的车速估计方法, 降低因景深变化导致的拥堵状态检测误差。通过融合3种不同维度信息得到拥堵指数, 拥堵指数聚类为5种拥堵类别以判断真实拥堵状态, 从而实现高速收费站的拥堵检测。实验结果表明, 在高速收费站拥堵数据集上, 采用多信息融合的拥堵检测算法准确率达到90.4%, 能够实现对收费站拥堵状态的准确检测。

items.title: 大语言模型智能体操作系统研究综述
items.title_zh: 大语言模型智能体操作系统研究综述
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型智能体操作系统,也叫智能体操作系统,是整合大模型、工具资源以及多智能体协同的核心平台,目前正逐渐成为推动通用人工智能发展的一个关键研究方向。对智能体操作系统领域的研究进展进行了系统梳理,首先从基础理论着手,回顾了多种大模型的演进情况以及智能体和传统操作系统领域的进展;接着,围绕典型体系结构,如AIOS等,阐述了其分层架构与模块化设计是怎样达成资源管理与智能调度的。进一步地,明确了当前智能体操作系统在上下文整合、扩展性以及安全性等方面面临的技术挑战,同时也提出了未来借助轻量化设计、自监督学习机制以及动态调度算法来提升多智能体协作效率。该研究的主要贡献为,将那些分散的研究给予整合,促使技术框架变得更为明晰,并指出了智能体操作系统对新兴体系以及行业定制化实践覆盖不全面的情况。未来的研究需要侧重推动跨域智能体操作系统自我进化的能力,并且加快其在各个领域的落地等。

items.title: 实际应用场景中的大模型高效推理技术综述
items.title_zh: 实际应用场景中的大模型高效推理技术综述
items.summary_zh: 近年来,大语言模型(Large Language Models,LLMs)技术迎来了快速发展,其在各行业的应用呈现出蓬勃增长的态势。从自然语言处理到智能推荐,再到信息检索和自动化写作,LLMs正逐渐成为许多领域中不可或缺的工具。然而,随着应用场景的逐渐多样化和需求的不断增加,LLMs推理效率问题日益凸显。在实际应用场景中,快速准确的推理能力对于响应用户请求、处理大规模数据和实时决策至关重要。为了应对这一挑战,学术界展开了广泛的研究和探索,致力于提高LLMs的推理效率。对此,全面调研了实际应用场景中有关LLMs高效推理的文献。首先,介绍了LLMs推理的原理,并分析了在实际应用场景中如何提高LLMs的推理效率。然后,引入了一个针对实际应用场景的分类系统,其主要分为3个层面,分别是算法优化层面、参数优化层面和系统优化层面;并对大模型进行相关研究的总结和归纳。最后,探讨了未来可能的研究方向。

items.title: 基于大语言模型的业务流程长尾变化应变方法
